title: Efficiency closed under Boolean negation
statement: Fix a verifier model $E$. It is closed under Boolean negation if, for every Boolean-valued verifier $M$, whenever the optional-output verifier associated with $M$ is efficient according to $E$, the verifier obtained by negating $M$'s output on every input and random-bit list also has an efficient associated optional-output verifier according to $E$.
